After a spicy-fresh opening, characterised by gentle bergamot and peppery spices, Interlude Man opens its heart to us. Here we are greeted by a lush variety of aromas, with sensual notes from the Far East.

A hint of soft leather blends in harmoniously, revealing the man's robust, distinctive side. A wicked smokiness settles over the balsamic warmth and plays with feelings of comfort and physicality.
A sense of arrival. Trust. Interlude.
A game that women can also play with ‘Interlude Man’!

La fragancia La Vie Est Belle, repleta de notas gourmand, frutales y florales, representa la posibilidad de vivir la vida a tu manera y la libertad de elegir tu propio camino hacia la felicidad.
fragancia frutal y floral gourmand para mujer
